key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9082
name: pack_board_state_bytes

name: unpack_board_state_bytes

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:91F0
name: check_both_sides_piece_limits
description: Counts each side's pieces and kings, returning the error text for a side with more than sixteen pieces or two or more kings. It also returns the king-adjacency message when the two kings touch.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9290
name: check_blue_piece_limit
description: Returns the Blue too-many-pieces message when Blue has more than sixteen pieces or two or more kings, and otherwise runs the king-adjacency test and a further check on the moving side.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:92A0
name: check_red_too_many_kings
description: Returns the too-many-kings message when the king counts reach two, and otherwise tests whether the two kings touch, returning the message when they do.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:92B0
name: check_blue_too_many_kings
description: Returns the Blue too-many-kings message when the king count is two or more, and otherwise tests whether the two kings touch, returning the matching text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:92C0
name: check_red_king_present
description: Returns the Red needs-a-King message when a side has no king, and otherwise tests whether the two kings touch, returning the matching text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:92D0
name: check_blue_king_present
description: Returns the Blue needs-a-King message when Blue has no king, and otherwise tests whether the two kings touch, returning the matching text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:92E0
name: check_kings_adjacent
description: Tests the eight direction offsets from one king's square for the other king's square and returns the adjacency message when they touch. Otherwise it runs a further legality test and returns the message only when that test fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:931C
name: check_blue_in_check
description: Tests the eight stored direction offsets from the Blue king's square for a matching attacker, then runs a further attack test if none matches. It returns the Blue is in Check message when the king is attacked.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:935E
name: return_red_check_message
description: Returns the fixed message text for Red being in check, with no other tests.

name: return_zero_result

name: clear_state_word_after_calls
description: Calls two routines and then clears a 16-bit state word in the shared data area.

name: return_maximum_of_halves
description: Compares the high 16-bit half of its 32-bit argument with the low half and returns the larger of the two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:947A
name: compute_absolute_value
description: Returns the absolute value of the low 16-bit half of its 32-bit argument by negating it when it is zero or negative.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9494
name: check_saved_move_pair
description: Adjusts the search depth around a routine that compares the current move pair with candidate pairs. It returns one when a stored pair matches and zero when the search flag is clear.

name: finish_turn_or_end_game
description: Tests whether the side to move has a legal move, and displays the game-over message with checkmate or stalemate text when it has none. Otherwise it swaps the side-to-move values, records the move when the move flag is set, and redraws the display.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:959C
name: select_piece_move_candidate
description: Saves the previous move pair, records the source square of the moving piece, and scans that piece's destination list. A destination that passes the test routine is stored as the chosen move, otherwise the default pair is restored.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:969E
name: unpack_square_attribute_flags
description: Looks up a two-byte square record and splits its second byte into two 2-bit fields and three 1-bit flags, each stored in its own state word. The first byte is written to a separate state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9746
name: pack_square_attribute_flags
description: Builds a two-byte square record from the stored state words: the first byte is copied from the stored value, and the second combines three 1-bit flags with two 2-bit fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:97AA
name: begin_deferred_move_check
description: Returns zero when no pending move exists or the state flag is already one or six. Otherwise it sets the flag to six, clears the pending value, calls a routine to evaluate the move, stores a nonzero result, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9808
name: conditionally_process_move_pair
description: Calls two routines on the pending move pair when the current side's state value equals two, then always calls two routines with the stored side value and the pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9860
name: read_one_byte_at_offset
description: Calls a routine with a base address plus the offset argument, reads one byte into a local buffer through a second routine, and returns that byte.

name: test_arguments_are_equal
description: Calls a routine with its two arguments and returns true when that routine reports zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:98BE
name: reset_square_table
description: Calls a routine with the square table base and a zero value, which initialises that table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:98D6
name: initialize_square_and_count_tables
description: Sets each of the 120 square table entries to sixteen, clears two rows of sixteen bytes in a second table, and sets two 16-bit counters to minus one before calling a routine on them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:995A
name: index_pieces_by_type
description: Walks the square table and, for each piece type from one to six, counts the pieces of that type and records their squares in a per-type list. A routine then finishes the per-type tables after the sixth type.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9A9A
name: decompile_timeout_unknown_routine
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out. The routine has 24 instructions and two other routines call it, so its purpose cannot be stated from the evidence.

name: swap_square_table_entries
description: Swaps two four-byte entries of the square table, then writes one byte into the board array at the slot indexed by the moved entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9B6C
name: clear_square_table_entry
description: Zeroes the first byte of one four-byte square table entry and clears the matching byte in the board array.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9BB6
name: set_square_table_entry
description: Stores two bytes into one four-byte square table entry and writes the matching pair of bytes into the board array at the slot that entry points to.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9C1C
name: store_square_and_track_maximum
description: Writes a value into a square table entry and into the board array at its slot, then raises a per-type value to the entry's stored value when that per-type value is lower.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9CC2
name: dispatch_move_effect_by_kind
description: Branches on the kind byte of the move: kinds one and six each call a set of routines with different square arguments, and every other kind calls one routine with the source or destination square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9DD0
name: precompute_ray_move_table
description: Clears a move table, then fills it for each direction offset by storing the offset and a per-direction value at every distance along each ray from each square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9EE2
name: check_piece_attacks_square
description: Tests whether a piece of a given type can reach a target square using the precomputed attack table. The sixth type defers to a routine, and sliding types walk the ray until they reach the target or an occupied square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:9FC4
name: check_pawn_attacks_square
description: Shifts the target square by a per-side step and tests the two squares diagonally beside it for a pawn-type piece of the given colour, returning one when a pawn attacks it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A062
name: check_any_piece_attacks_square
description: Returns one when a routine already flags the target square. Otherwise it walks the stored piece list for the given side from last to first and returns one when any piece's test succeeds against that square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A108
name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out. The routine has 36 instructions and two routines call it, so its purpose cannot be stated from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A178
name: find_square_in_history
description: Checks that a square holds the expected piece type and colour, then searches the saved history entries from newest to oldest for that square. It returns the matching history index, one when the piece matches but no entry does, and zero when the piece is absent.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A20E
name: validate_piece_state
description: Returns true when a record's short field is zero, its second flag byte is zero, and its piece byte is neither empty nor the sixth type.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A266
name: count_consecutive_matching_entries
description: Walks the saved history backwards from the current depth, calling a test on each entry, and returns how many consecutive entries pass before one fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A2A2
name: count_history_moves_to_bound
description: Walks the saved move history and the piece-square values from the current depth, counting entries until a search bound is reached. The routine is long, so only its loop structure and returned counts are evidenced.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A480
name: return_word_at_offset
description: Returns the 16-bit value stored two bytes before a base address in the shared data area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A488
name: validate_candidate_move_type
description: Tests a candidate move for the piece type given, using separate branches for the first type, the sixth type and all others. It returns a flag pair describing whether the move is allowed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_history_move_pair
description: Appends the current move pair to the saved history list while it has room for another entry, then increments the stored count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: iterate_phases_two_to_five
description: Sets a flag, calls one routine for each phase value from two to five, and then clears the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: search_pawn_and_piece_captures
description: Checks the three squares beside the given square for pawn-type pieces of the opposing side, then tests each remaining piece of the side to move against the destination square. It returns the result of the last test.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: generate_piece_destinations
description: Generates destination squares for the piece on the source square by type: types one and five test eight fixed offsets, types two to four slide along rays until blocked, and type six handles pawn advances and captures. Each destination is passed to an evaluation routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: generate_side_move_candidates
description: Clears the move counters, runs a routine for every piece of both sides, and then tests the squares around a stored piece when a condition holds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: pop_history_move_pair
description: Reads the next saved move pair from the history list while entries remain, otherwise loads the default pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of the low 16-bit half of its 32-bit argument.

name: compute_position_evaluation_score
description: Scans the board to total the material values and build attack weights for each square, then combines them into a position score. The source listing stops partway through the attack scan, so later steps are not evidenced.

name: count_flagged_bits_in_word
description: Shifts a 16-bit word right one bit at a time, calls a test routine for each bit, and returns how many bits passed.

name: compute_weighted_negative_sum
description: Reads three values through a routine and returns their negated sum, weighted by eight, twenty and forty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_piece_square_bonus
description: Computes a table index from a piece type, square and side, then returns the stored entry at that index plus a per-type base value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: update_depth_bitmasks_difference
description: Updates a pair of bit masks for the current depth by clearing and merging bits, calls two routines, and returns the difference of their results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: merge_depth_bitmasks_difference
description: Merges the bit masks for two squares into the current depth's pair of masks, calls two routines, and returns the difference between their results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: score_candidate_move
description: Scores a candidate move by combining the values of the moving and captured pieces with per-kind bonuses and a penalty term, then returns the difference from the stored baseline.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: search_best_root_move
description: Sets the search window with a large positive bound, evaluates root moves at increasing depth up to the depth limit, and then loops until a move is selected.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_search_should_continue
description: Returns zero when no search is active, or when the search depth is below its limit and the side flag is set. Otherwise it returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: locate_pawns_per_side
description: Clears a 24-entry pair table, sets two tracked squares to a sentinel value, then scans each side's piece range for pawn-type pieces and records their squares.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: evaluate_root_and_store_best
description: Sets a flag from a stored value, clears a counter, calls a routine with its argument, and stores the result as the best value while the counter stays zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: report_timeout_routine_122
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out. The routine has 122 instructions and two routines call it, so its purpose cannot be stated from the evidence.

name: search_move_phases_for_node
description: Runs one search node by copying the current move list and trying candidate moves in ordered phases. It returns early when a routine reports a cutoff.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: search_alpha_beta_node
description: Runs one recursive search node: it pushes the position, makes and unmakes candidate moves through routines, and updates the best score and window bounds. It returns early when a bound cutoff is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: record_move_in_depth_slots
description: Stores a candidate move in a two-slot list for the current depth when the move flag is set, moving the older slot into the second position. The newer move becomes the first slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: check_depth_move_slots
description: Returns one when a routine accepts the current move or either of the two stored moves at this depth, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: update_lower_bound_window
description: Returns one when the value is not above the first bound, and raises the second bound to the value when it is higher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: process_search_step_outcome
description: Handles the outcome of one search step: it scores the current move, updates the stored move and score, and returns zero or one depending on whether the node is cut off.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: apply_first_ply_move_bonus
description: At the first ply it classifies the move into one of four categories and adds a scaled bonus to two score fields. Deeper in the search it returns one when a routine reports a cutoff.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: store_move_and_root_bound
description: Copies the current move pair into the move stack at this depth, and at the root saves the current bound value, updating the root bound when the mode value is five.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: try_phases_two_to_five

name: copy_string_and_append_space

name: is_printable_character
description: Returns one when the character code is between thirty-two and one hundred and twenty-six inclusive, the printable range, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1055E
name: compact_active_save_slots
description: Clears a buffer, then copies each save slot record whose flag is set into the next free row, storing its slot index in the row's last byte and recording how many rows were filled.

name: rebuild_active_slot_rows
description: Clears eight 16-byte rows, then copies each active slot record into the next row, stores its slot index in the row's last byte, and records how many rows were filled.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1059A
name: append_active_slot_rows
description: Copies each active slot record into the next row of the table, stores its slot index in the row's last byte, and records how many rows were filled.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:105F4
name: draw_save_slot_list
description: Draws the eight save-slot rows through a text routine, then draws the count and the selected slot text. The referenced text includes the dashed empty-slot label and the Load label.

name: draw_save_panel_frame
description: Sets a text style, draws a filled panel at fixed screen coordinates, and draws the outline of the save list area over it.

name: draw_save_menu_labels
description: Sets a text style, then draws two fixed labels, an optional third label when its argument is non-zero, and a final label at fixed offsets.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10806
name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Clears the text area, sets a text style, and draws the Cancel and Done labels, with an extra border when its argument is non-zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:108A2
name: draw_rectangle_outline
description: Builds a closed rectangle from the four values of the argument record, moves to its top-left corner, and draws its outline through a five-point drawing routine.

name: open_game_window
description: Opens the game display window from a stored definition and keeps its handle. When opening fails it shows the unable-to-open-a-window message, and it returns whether the handle is non-zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10948
name: return_one_result
description: Returns one with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10966
name: close_game_window
description: When the window handle is set, closes the window through a library call, clears the handle, and then calls one more routine.

name: open_named_file_block
description: Opens a file named in a 32-byte buffer and transfers 512 bytes between it and the given buffer, then closes it. When the open fails it calls a routine with the buffer and a fixed constant instead, and it returns whether the file opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:109D6
name: run_one_call_return_one
description: Calls a library routine and one other routine, then returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:109F4
name: transfer_named_file_block_two
description: Opens a second named file from a 32-byte buffer, transfers 512 bytes through the given buffer when it opens, closes it, and returns whether it opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10A26
name: run_two_calls_return_one
description: Calls two routines and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10A44
name: build_saves_path_prefix
description: Writes an empty first byte into the buffer, then when the device handle is not set it copies the ChessSaves name and calls a routine, and it always appends the ChessSaves colon prefix. The referenced text is ChessSaves and ChessSaves colon.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10A90
name: initialise_request_and_send
description: Fills a request record with zero fields, a constant value of two and argument-derived values, then passes it to a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10AE4
name: initialise_serial_port
description: Opens the serial device named in a shared buffer, points the receive ring buffer at a fixed area, and writes the serial period and interrupt request registers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10B26
name: send_serial_bytes
description: Sends a block of bytes one at a time through the serial data register, waiting for the transmit buffer to empty before each byte and setting the stop bit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10B4A
name: send_serial_bytes_loop
description: Writes each byte of a buffer to the serial data register with the stop bit set, waiting for the transmit buffer to empty before each one, until the counter reaches zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10B5E
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10B66
name: receive_serial_bytes_timeout
description: Reads the requested number of bytes from the receive ring buffer, waiting on a timer for each byte. It returns zero when the count is reached and minus one when a byte does not arrive before the timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BB0
name: read_serial_ring_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the receive ring buffer into the destination while the count lasts, waiting on a timer for new bytes. It returns zero when all bytes arrive and minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns the constant minus one to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BE8
name: read_serial_ring_bytes_loop
description: Loops over the receive ring buffer, copying each byte to the destination while the count lasts and waiting on a timer for new bytes. It returns zero when the count is exhausted and minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEE
name: flush_receive_ring_buffer
description: Sets the receive ring buffer read position equal to its write position, discarding any bytes waiting in it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10BFC
name: count_receive_ring_bytes
description: Returns the number of bytes waiting in the 128-byte receive ring buffer, computed from the write and read positions with wraparound.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10C1E
name: count_ring_free_space
description: Returns the free space in the 128-byte ring buffer between the write position and the other position, with wraparound.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10C36
name: set_serial_interrupt_control
description: Writes the serial interrupt control value and calls a library routine with a stored handle and the constant eleven.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10C54
name: store_received_serial_byte
description: Stores one received byte from the argument record into the 128-byte receive ring buffer at the write position, then advances and wraps that position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10C7E
name: send_packet_with_ack_retry
description: Computes a two-character checksum over the packet bytes, sends the packet and checksum through a serial send routine, then waits for an acknowledgement. On timeout it sends a fixed marker and empties the packet, and it reports a protocol message when the reply is wrong.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10CAC
name: send_checksummed_packet_wait
description: Adds each packet byte into a two-byte checksum, sends the packet and checksum, then waits for up to five reply bytes. It reports a protocol message when a reply is unexpected.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10D08
name: await_packet_reply
description: Reads reply bytes from the serial line for up to five attempts, handling the marker and acknowledgement bytes and returning when a reply arrives. A timeout clears the packet, and an unexpected byte reports a protocol message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10D2C
name: retry_on_send_collision
description: Repeats the reply-reading loop for a packet, handling marker and reply bytes. The referenced text is Sending at the same time, try again, which is the collision message shown on this path.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10D4C
name: wait_for_opponent_reply
description: Waits for up to five reply bytes on the serial line, handling marker bytes, and shows the opponent-not-responding message when no reply arrives in time. The referenced text is Opponent not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10DBA
name: parse_received_packet
description: Checks a received packet's header byte and length, verifies its two-character checksum, and when the checksum matches it handles the packet by type, sending an acknowledgement code where required.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10E42
name: send_and_match_reply_packet
description: Sends a packet with a checksum and compares incoming bytes against a stored two-byte reply pattern. It returns zero when the reply matches a known packet type and minus one when no reply arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10E72
name: read_modem_response_line
description: Reads characters from the serial line into a line buffer until a carriage return arrives, then compares the line with the echo command text and sends the matching response.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10E7A
name: send_sync_and_read_line
description: Sends a four-byte sync code chosen by a stored flag, then reads the reply line with the same handling as the modem response routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10E88
name: send_fixed_sync_and_read
description: Sends the fixed four-byte sync code, then reads the reply line using the same handling as the other response routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero without performing any other operations or accessing memory.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10EAC
name: dispatch_packet_type_response
description: Sends a sync code for packet type 166 or sets a ready flag for type 170, then reads incoming bytes and returns minus one when no data arrives. Other packet types return zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10EBA
name: read_serial_command_lines
description: Repeatedly waits for serial input, collects carriage-return-terminated lines, checks each line against the echo command text, and returns minus one when no input arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10EC6
name: start_serial_line_reading
description: Sets a stored flag to one and runs the serial line reading loop, returning minus one when input stops.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10ED2
name: poll_serial_line_input
description: Runs the serial line reading loop once per poll, returning minus one when no further input arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10EDA
name: handle_serial_line_or_packet
description: Collects one carriage-return-terminated line or handles a packet header, checks the echo command text, and returns minus one when no further input arrives.
